|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">電子双眼鏡の映像。目標の方位、高さ、距離が正確に表示される。暗視機能を内蔵する。</span>''
|translation='''Title:''' Long-range scan.

'''Card text:''' Spend 2 Force to deploy beside the opponent's Reserve Deck. You may spend 1 Force at any time to look at the top card of that deck. If a card anywhere on the table is in ‘nighttime conditions,’ you may look at the top three cards instead of one.

'''Lore:''' An electrobinocular image. The target's direction, height and distance are displayed accurately. It has built-in night vision.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to a card on the table being in nighttime conditions; the English says nighttime conditions exist anywhere on the table. The Japanese lore describes the displayed direction, height and distance; the English specifies true and relative azimuth, elevation and range.
